lead: A Windows path handed to `npm run … -- --nvs <path>` from a POSIX shell loses its backslashes, and the host suite then fails six tests that read as a broken server.
body: `npm.cmd` re-quotes what it forwards, so `E:\mwl\target\debug\nvs.exe` reaches `scripts/host.mjs` as `mwltargetdebugnvs.exe`, which `resolve` takes as relative to `editors/vscode`. Reproduce the driver's check with forward slashes — `--nvs E:/mwl/target/debug/nvs.exe` — and read the status item's detail in the failure before believing the tree.
